description: "The Secrets of the Great City" by Edward Winslow Martin is a descriptive work written during the late 19th century that explores the complexities of life in New York City. It delves into the dualities of the metropolis, discussing both its remarkable virtues and its stark vices, while painting a portrait of the diverse population that inhabits it.
